title: Pack manifest (data/packs/<id>/pack.json)
description: One per pack folder (0.4 P1, DATA-FORMAT-V2 §2.1). A pack is a game, a class, a faction or a guide; `id` is its folder below the packs root. The generator resolves the chain (parent, then uses), loads exactly the files listed here and fails on a listed file that is missing, a JSON file in the folder that is not listed, an unknown parent / uses or a cycle.

id.description: The pack's folder below the packs root: the game, then one segment per level (aion2, aion2/classes/assassin, aion2/asmodian, aion2/asmodian/assassin).

parent.description: The pack this one extends. A game has none; every other kind has one.

uses.description: Other packs this one reads (not extends), e.g. a guide uses its class.

files.description: Every data file of the pack, relative to its folder, in load order. Not pack.json, not a nested pack's files.

checks.description: Optional (0.4 P6a): the pack's own cross-record checks, an ES module relative to its folder that exports checks(ctx, check). The generator runs it after its engine checks, in chain order; a pack without one gets the engine checks only.
